title: Chapter 79 Jiangbei, The God Of War
content:
Chapter 79 Jiangbei, The God Of War

After a long silence, Lu Daosheng sighed.

As his future stronghold in this star field, he still attaches great importance to this Xinhuang City.

However, most of the people in the wilderness city in the Ten Thousand Spirit Realm have not reached this level yet, so Lu Daosheng can only temporarily hand over the city to Qin Yi and others to take care of.

But relying on Qin Yi and the others alone is still a bit insufficient.

When he was in place, Lu Daosheng moved and disappeared directly into the starry sky.

......

Somewhere in the star field, a simple little house.

Next to the house, the two of them sat opposite each other and were quietly tasting tea.

"Brother Jiang, you have been here for 30 million years. Don't you want to go out and see the scenery outside?"

At this time, one of them spoke.

Hearing this, the other man drank the tea in his hand and then chuckled, "Chuang Chuang? Let's forget it. I am no longer invincible in the entire Wuling Star Domain, so why bother to do that."

Hearing this, the man shook his head and smiled.

This is a proud statement, but it is a fact.

Because the guy named Jiangbei in front of me is the strongest man in the Martial Spirit Star Field now, he is even named the God of Martial Arts and is famous all over the world.

Martial God, this is not a realm, but a kind of honorific title.

Only those who are strong enough and recognized by all martial arts powerhouses can be called a martial god.

In other words, you must defeat the opponent by all the powerful martial arts.

This move is like a difficult task to ascend to heaven.

However, Jiangbei did it.

One person fought all over the Wuling Star Domain, and even the nearby powerful star domains were no exception. All the strong men were beaten up by Jiang Bei.

Jiangbei has suppressed countless eras in the Wuling Star Domain with his own strength. It is the myth of the Wuling Star Domain and the pride of the Wuling Star Domain.

When the outside world mentioned the Wuling Star Domain, the first thing that comes to mind was the martial god who was known as invincible.

"Don't talk about me anymore. What about you? Haven't you untied the knot in your heart?"

At this time, Jiang Bei looked at the middle-aged man with pale hair in front of him.

Hearing Jiang Bei's words, the middle-aged man laughed, but his smile was very bitter.

Shaking his head, the middle-aged man said nothing.

Seeing this, Jiang Bei just sighed and then continued to drink tea.

I have to say that the tea today is pretty good.

The fragrance is everywhere.

"Lao Yu, your tea making skills have improved again."

Jiang Bei smiled.

"Can I try it too?"

As soon as the words finished, a sudden voice rang out from the side.

......

Half a quarter of an hour ago.

Lu Daosheng moved forward all the way, and the strongest person in the Wuling Star Domain was named the God of Martial Arts.

If this person can be allowed to join the Huangcheng, then the Huangcheng in the Xuanling Star Domain will inevitably have a great increase in its strength.

Now, there is indeed a strong man to guard it.

And it's famous.

That martial god was Lu Daosheng's first goal.

At this moment, Lu Daosheng suddenly stopped and then turned to look at another deep starry sky.

There was pitch black.

Countless strange cracks in the abyss are constantly intertwining.

Death Star Field.

A place that is regarded as hell and a forbidden place by countless people.

Looking at it, Lu Daosheng was silent for a moment, then deduced for a while, and suddenly, Lu Daosheng's expression lit up.

"Oh? I didn't expect that this Death Star Domain and my Huangcheng still have such a fate."

Immediately, Lu Daosheng's palm spread out and a figure appeared in front of him.

It's just empty.

Last time he asked Kong Lai to stare at the remains of the three human forces in the Wanling Realm, but due to his temporary decision, the matter was left incomplete.

At this time, Kong had reached the peak of the realm of the Divine Realm, only one step away from the realm of the Divine Realm.

Among all Lu Daosheng's subordinates, Kong only has the fastest cultivation speed, and Kong has no position in the deserted city, so Kong can cultivate to this level in such a short time.

Looking at Kong, Lu Daosheng said, "Kong, there is a great opportunity that belongs to you, and it will also be of great benefit to my wasteland city."

"However, this trip is full of dangers. If you are not careful, you will most likely fall there. Are you willing to go?"

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Kong almost hesitated and knelt down on one knee and said, "Kong is willing to go, thank you Lord City!"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded.

Although there are very few things to be told to Kong on weekdays, Kong has never disappointed him.

In his eyes, Huo has great potential, and Lu Daosheng also values him very much.

Then Lu Daosheng said, "Go, I'll wait for you to come back in the deserted city."

"Yes, Lord City Lord."

Leaving empty.

Go towards the death star field that represents endless crisis.

In the dark, looking at Kong's back, Lu Daosheng bounced his fingers and an invisible force quietly poured into Kong's body.

If his deduction is not wrong, then when the sky steps out of the death star field, the sky will transform again.

.........

Next to the hut of Wushen Mountain.

Hearing the strange voice beside him, Jiang Bei Yu Qingfeng and the others changed their faces.

when? !

Someone could actually appear on the side without their perception.

He suddenly turned his head and looked at him, and suddenly saw a man looking at them with a smile on his face.

Who else can Lu Daosheng say if he is not?

"Who are you?"

Looking at Lu Daosheng, the two of them said solemnly.

Is there such a strong man in this world?

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng introduced himself: "My name is Lu Daosheng, and I am the lord of Huangcheng."

"Huangcheng?"

Hearing the word Huangcheng, both of them shook their heads.

"Never heard of it."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was not angry. After all, in these major star fields, their Huangcheng has not yet made a name for themselves.

But he believed that day would not be too long.

"It doesn't matter if I haven't heard of it. Are you the God of War in Wuling Star Field?"

At this time, Lu Daosheng looked at the two of them, then looked at Jiangbei and said.

The strength of the two of them has already stood at the top in this star field.

They have all reached the peak of the God Lord Realm.

(Heavenly Fate Realm, Heaven-breaking Realm, God-Approaching Realm, God-King Realm, God-Lord Realm, God-Lord Realm, God-Lord Realm, God-Lord Realm, God-Lord Realm, God-Lord Realm, God-Lord Realm)

After hearing what Lu Daosheng said, Jiang Bei nodded.

"Yes, it's me. Why, do you want to challenge me too?"

At this time, Jiang Bei had regained his confidence again. He thought that maybe he was careless, or maybe the other party had practiced some god-level body skills, which led to the other party quietly appearing here without his awareness.

If a fight really breaks out, he is not afraid of anyone.

This is the confidence of a martial god.

Looking at Jiang Bei's confident look, Yu Qingfeng frowned slightly.

He felt that Lu Daosheng was extremely extraordinary.

But Jiang Bei was not a simple person either. To be narcissistic, could a friend worth making be an ordinary person?

Then, Yu Qingfeng looked at the two of them indifferently without interrupting.

"Challenge?"

Lu Daosheng smiled and shook his head.

"I came here this time to invite you to join my Desolate City."

Forget about the challenge, Jiang Bei is indeed strong, otherwise I wouldn't have come all the way to find him.

But I am too far ahead of him, fighting with Jiang Bei is bullying him.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words.

Jiang Bei was stunned.

And Yu Qingfeng on the side was a little surprised.

Didn't hear it wrong, this guy actually wanted Jiang Bei to join the Desolate City that he had never heard of.

Who is Jiang Bei? He is a legend in the Wuling Star Domain and the faith of countless people in the Wuling Star Domain.

God of War!

If the world knew what happened today, Lu Daosheng would be drowned in spit.

Who do you think you are? You dare to say such things to the God of War.

"Hahahaha, interesting."

At this time, Jiang Bei suddenly laughed and looked at Lu Daosheng with some amusement.

Wanted him to join the Desolate City and become the subordinate of the person in front of him.

It was really ridiculous.

Then, Jiang Bei stood up, and a terrifying martial arts aura suddenly surged out of his body.

On the side, Yu Qingfeng saw this and quickly retreated a few steps to the distance.

He knew that Jiang Bei was going to get serious.

Jiang Bei twisted his neck, and a creaking sound came from his neck.

Then, Jiang Bei looked at Lu Daosheng and said directly: "Come on, today, if you can take three of my moves, I, Jiang Bei, will join your so-called deserted city."
